name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Wade, Crappie, and Nightcrawler belong to different catches.
Exactly one of these is true: Gus goes with Trout; Mabel goes with Corn; Wade goes with Bass.
Gus goes with none of Crappie, Pike, or Shrimp.
Shrimp goes with Wade if and only if Boone does not go with Bass.
Corn, Maggot, and Nightcrawler go with Gus, Mabel, and Wade, in some order.
